description: This file defines the 'Modification' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Event' namespace, which extends a base Controller class. It contains methods for handling different types of components (controller, model, view, library) related to modifications via route parsing and file existence checks.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Controller class for handling different component types (controller, model, view, library) for modifications in the OpenCart catalog using route parsing and file existence logic.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Normalizes the route to ensure it points to an extension/modification controller file, appending the prefix if missing.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Determines the model class name from the route, adjusts the route if the model PHP file exists in the extension directory.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Normalizes view template route, adjusting for Twig templates if necessary.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Adjusts the route for library files located in the system library directory.
